text:
ava: Heads-up, we started getting a cluster of latency alerts from shared-gpu-pool-c around 2026-03-18T03:20Z. p95 jumped to ~700ms for ~7m.
jon: Saw the alerts. Throughput dropped ~25% for that pool. KV eviction rate spiked.
mike: Dashboards point to one tenant with lots of tiny batches and repeated kernel flips. Tagging @tara @sam for traces.
tara: I pulled a short profiler. Pattern: lots of size=1/2 batches, kernel-affinity table churn, and GPU mutex waits. Looks like the autotuner keeps oscillating.
sam: Runtime excerpt (trimmed):
```
2026-03-18T03:19:58Z RateLimiter grant=96 tenant=lyra
2026-03-18T03:20:01Z BatchSubmit size=1 tenant=lyra latency_ms=682
2026-03-18T03:20:01Z KernelSelect chosen=quant_v3 tenant=helix
2026-03-18T03:20:02Z RequestCancelled id=zzz tenant=lyra
# no RateLimiter.return logged for this cancel
2026-03-18T03:20:02Z RateLimiter grant=96 tenant=lyra
2026-03-18T03:20:03Z KVCache evict tenant=pegasus slot=17 reason=slot_pressure
```
ava: So the cancellation path isn't returning tokens, letting lyra hoard concurrency -> micro-batches -> autotuner thrash -> KV exhaustion for others.
jon: Any recent changes touching adaptive-batching or cancel hot-path?
mike: PR #4488 from Mar 16 changed the adaptive batching window and refactored cancel handling to avoid double-returns. Looks related.
tara: Kernel-autotuner is too aggressive: with high jitter in seq_len it flips kernels on each tiny batch. We should make switches hysteretic when avg_batch_size < 4. Filed issue #4312.
sam: Immediate mitigation: applied per-tenant hard cap 20 to tenant=lyra on pool-c.
infra-bot: applied hard_cap tenant=lyra pool=shared-gpu-pool-c cap=20 by mike at 2026-03-18T03:22:40Z
ava: After cap p95 fell back to ~60ms in ~90s and throughput rose to ~97% baseline.
mike: Reverted PR #4488 in prod to stop the leak. infra-bot: revert deploy 2026-03-18T03:28:12Z
tara: I'm preparing a fix branch fix/4488-token-return. Patch will make RateLimiter.return strongly-ordered and idempotent and add unit/integration tests that exercise cancel under batching.
sam: Also proposing autotuner debounce: when running avg_batch_size < 3 for 5s, stop kernel flips and prefer stable kernel until batch pattern stabilizes. I'll prototype and test.
ava: Action items:
- tara: open PR with token-return fix + tests (ETA 8h)
- sam: implement autotuner debounce for low-batch mode (issue #4312)
- mike: keep hard cap on lyra for 24h and monitor metrics
- jon: run KV-slot audit and consider short-term reservation increase for pool-c
- ava: write postmortem with timeline, graphs, logs, and follow-ups
sam: I'll add a dashboard for grant_count vs return_count per tenant and an alert rule for grant-return delta > 5 for 1m.
mike: Also temporarily increased KV reserved_slots for pool-c by +12 to blunt eviction ripple. infra-bot: reserve_kv_slots pool=shared-gpu-pool-c extra=12
jon: Root cause hypothesis for postmortem: batching refactor missed a cancel return path -> tenant retained excess concurrency -> micro-batches -> kernel-autotuner oscillation + KV slot pressure -> cross-tenant latency/throughput impact.
ava: Scheduling a 45m postmortem 2026-03-18 14:30 PT. Assigning owners for long-term fixes. Thanks all for the quick triage :thumbsup:
mike: Will follow up with canary plan once PR lands.
tara: I'll run targeted cancel-repro tests in perf harness tonight and attach results.
sam: Added unit+integration tests simulating rapid cancel loops asserting zero net token leak.
ava: Closing this thread for now; reopen if we see recurrence. :eyes:
